contexts.text: Upon His head many diadems () = all the things of faith.
Upon His head many diadems = all the goods and truths of faith.
That precious stones and diadems = Divine truths in their ultimates, has been manifestly evident to me from the precious stones and diadems in the Spiritual World...
As various diadems make beauty in a king's crown.
Seven diadems = the holy things of the Word and Church profaned.
These varieties may be compared to the various diadems (or jewels) in a king's crown. AR 73. (Compare TCR 763:end.)
Upon his heads seven diadems () = all the truths of the Word falsified and profaned.

By diadems or precious stones are signified the truths of the Word; in special, the truths of the sense of the letter; but here, these falsified and profaned, because they were seen upon the seven heads of the dragon...

The reason the truths of the Word also falsified and profaned are called diadems, is that they shine of themselves, with whomsoever they are, as diadems do on earth in whose ever hand they are... Adulterous women seen adorned with diadems; and also Jews selling diadems, which they had procured from Heaven. AE 717:3.
Upon his horns ten diadems () = the power of falsifying many truths of the Word.
Upon His head many diadems () = the Divine truths of the Word from Him.
Hence it is, that diadems = the Divine truths of the Word in the sense of its letter.
In her hair were inserted flowers of diadems.
Upon his heads seven diadems = Divine truths in the ultimate of order, which are the truths of the sense of the letter of the Word; here, adulterated and profaned.

That the truths of the sense of the letter of the Word appears as diadems, may be evident from the diadems in the Spiritual World... Hence also it is that the noble women below the Heavens adorn themselves with diadems... These diadems in Heaven, and thence in the lower places, are from the Lord, and from the spiritual light which is from Him; they are the ultimates of that light, which are called effects, and are representative forms of affections of truth from good; thus are Divine truths in the ultimate of order... As this is the origin of precious stones, some in the World of Spirits are allowed to form diadems by means of the ingraftings of certain truths from the sense of the letter of the Word; but these diadems are not genuine; in hardness they are like crystals, because they are made by art.
Hence it is evident what is signified by diadems or precious stones. Illustrated.
Upon his horns ten diadems = power from the appearances of truth in abundance. Explained.
Like harlots adorned over the forehead and beneath the ears with diadems.
